subject: UNACCEPTABLE OUTAGE! Entire workspace board disappeared during investor demo!
body: I am absolutely LIVID right now. In the middle of an in-person Series A investor presentation, our entire Product Launch board went completely blank with a 404 NOT FOUND error! I looked like a complete idiot in front of 6 venture capitalists because your platform crashed. I want an explanation from your VP of Engineering IMMEDIATELY or we are canceling our Team contract and pursuing legal remedies for breach of SLA!
